name: Placer County, CA
findings: Placer County has 1,261 nonprofit organizations. 557 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 433 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Placer County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few housing organizations list public events
observations.text: No housing organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through housing groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 110 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
